discount_rate_real.justification: Real discount rate for long-lived infrastructure with technology risk. Not given by the organizer. Used identically for all alternatives; sensitivity 0–12 % in experiments/run_sensitivity.py.

discount_t0_year.justification: Annual cash flows dated at the start of each year; PV factor = 1/(1+r)^(year-2035).

prep_period_start.justification: Earliest order date of the preparatory period (Earth-Core needs 12 months before 2035-01).

lead_time_policy.justification: Conservative end of the organizer lead-time ranges (Earth-New 24 months, ISRU 2 months).

weeks_per_month.justification: 365/12/7. Week lead times converted with ceil(weeks/4.345) -> Emergency 6 weeks = 2 months.

days_per_month.justification: 365/12; day-denominated lead times converted with ceil.

zbo_commissioning_lag_months.justification: Case gives no ZBO build time; modernization active from the CAPEX month. Varied in sensitivity.

earth_new_post_commissioning_lead_months.justification: The 18–24 month Earth-New lead time is read as decision-to-first-delivery; orders are placed during preparation.

isru_commissioning_month.justification: Lunar-ISRU available from 2038 once CAPEX is financed before 2038.

source_investment_link.justification: Earth-New capacity requires the exercised option; Lunar-ISRU requires the pilot CAPEX.

storage_investment_link.justification: ZBO modernization switches the active storage mode (capacity 120 t, losses 1.2 %, OPEX 12/yr).

emergency_base_share_threshold.justification: Emergency counts as the base channel in a year when its ordered volume exceeds 20 % of that year's demand.

holding_cost_averaging.justification: Average physical stock per month = (I_start + I_end)/2; holding = 0.72 x average x 1/12.

storage_capacity_check.justification: Hard violation when end-of-month stock > capacity; warning when stock after inflow (before withdrawals) > capacity.

emergency_reserve_equivalence.justification: Contracted Emergency reserve counts only if stock covers demand during the 6-week lead time and reserved Emergency capacity >= R_y.

opening_stock_reservation_years.justification: The preparatory-period purchase pays the source reservation rate on the purchased tonnage for one year; booked in 2035.

prep_period_holding_charged.justification: Holding cost charged from 2035-01; storage time in the preparatory period (< 1 month) is not charged.

intra_year_demand_profile.justification: Organizer convention — uniform demand within the year, 365 days.
